turns.text: I can imagine, those Mondays can be hectic. Did you manage to get any exercise in today, or is it a rest day?

turns.text: Definitely. Tonight, Grace and I are just going to relax. We're going to put on a sci-fi series on that new streaming service we signed up for.

turns.text: A sci-fi series is the perfect way to wind down a Monday. I hope you and Grace enjoy the show and have a relaxing night!

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Thanks! It should be a quiet, nice evening. Talk to you later!
